title: Families of solid map objects (data/solid_families.yaml)
description: docs/06 "Qué bloquea el paso": words of item ids (split at "_") that name a family of objects that physically stand in the way (tree, bush, crate...). A map object (kind: decoration, pickupable: false) of one of them must write blocks_movement, true or false. Read by the validator only.
